推一推成长时间。先找后腿，再找前腿，最后盯住小尾巴。: Move along the growing timeline. Look for back legs, then front legs, and finally watch the tail.

长尾巴的小蝌蚪: A tadpole with a long tail
卵外面有一层像果冻的胶质。里面的小生命慢慢发育，孵出蝌蚪。: A jelly-like layer surrounds each egg. The young animal develops inside and hatches as a tadpole.
蝌蚪用尾巴游泳。多数青蛙会经历这样的水中幼体阶段。: A tadpole swims with its tail. Most frogs have a stage like this in water.
后腿先明显长出来。尾巴还在，身体正在继续变化。: Back legs become visible first. The tail is still there while the body keeps changing.
四条腿都看得见了，尾巴开始明显变短。肺等结构也在发育。: All four legs are visible, and the tail becomes shorter. Lungs and other structures are developing too.
尾巴被身体逐渐吸收了，不是掉下来了。小青蛙可以用腿游泳和跳跃。: The tail is gradually absorbed by the body; it does not fall off. The little frog can swim and jump with its legs.
